search.description: Native public Search/Fetch; separate credential required

memory_recall_guidance.description: Use native memory navigation for missing personal facts; no extra classifier or public search

proactive.description: Operator activation switch; supports dated trial or explicitly configured continuous operation. Pending policy does not enable sending.

context_compression_fallback_turns.description: Native summary failure only: retain at most this many complete recent rounds before the token safety check; 0 disables this adapter. Pending approved value: 80.

preferred_address.description: Private runtime binding for the user-confirmed address

proactive_window.description: Trial retains dated expiry. Continuous: mode=continuous, start/end=0, max_per_day=5, max_generations_per_day=5, cooldown=10800, quiet_hours=[0,9].

mode.description: trial is the compatibility default for existing dated configurations; continuous has no scheduled expiry.

quiet_hours.description: Asia/Shanghai quiet [start,end). Trial [23,9]; continuous [0,9] permits 09:00:00 through 23:59:59.

max_generations_per_day.description: Explicit daily model-evaluation budget, including defer/skip/errors. 0 only means inherit the existing trial daily limit; continuous must explicitly set 1..5 (approved: 5).

memory_topic_aliases.description: 资料主题同义词（仅定位主题，不填用户事实）
